verdict.rationale: LocalAI runs as an HTTP server with an OpenAI-compatible API on port 8080, shown published via `docker run -p 8080:8080`. Its multi-user mode (admin/user roles, OAuth login, per-user API keys) and distributed worker nodes that self-register with a coordinator show it is built to be reached from other machines, not just localhost. Missing for 10: explicit docs on binding to a LAN address or setting the listen interface, and independent or hands-on confirmation of access from other devices.
